page_title: EMP 0-3 ATA | Empoli v Atalanta 30/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' Luis Muriel (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+2' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Empoli.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Good chance! Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!

87' Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Etrit Berisha was alert and the score remained the same.
86' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Matteo Ruggeri will be replaced by Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta).
86' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Mario Pasalic.
85' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) sees a yellow card from Luca Massimi after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
84' Rough tackle by Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Razvan Marin as he is replaced by Simone Bastoni (Empoli).
81' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Etrit Berisha comes off the line to clear the ball away.
81' The ball is out of play. Empoli will have a chance to score from a corner.

80' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort. Empoli will take a corner kick.
78' A pass into the penalty area from Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is intercepted by the defence.
76' Substitution. Luis Muriel (Atalanta) replaces Ademola Lookman.
75' Aurelio Andreazzoli has decided to substitute Matteo Cancellieri and he is replaced by Daniel Maldini (Empoli).
74' That's the end of the game for Youssef Maleh, who is replaced by Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli).
72' The referee awards a corner and Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) goes over to take it.
72' The corner is swung into the six-yard box and Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) gets his head on the ball, but he is unable to keep it down and it goes miles over the bar.
71' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
71' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee blows his whistle, Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
69' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) has received a yellow card for his foul.
69' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Luca Massimi no option but to blow his whistle.
68' Empoli are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
66' It is time for a substitution. Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) is on for Teun Koopmeiners.
65' Substitution. Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) in, Gianluca Scamacca out.
65' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atalanta will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
63' Aurelio Andreazzoli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) replacing Sebastian Walukiewicz.
63' Substitution. Nicolo Cambiaghi walks off the pitch and Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) comes on as a substitute.
63' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) shakes his head in disbelief after spurning a great chance. He took the rebound on the edge of the box and smashed the ball against the crossbar!
62' Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) sends a cross into the box, but Juan Musso comes off his line to gather the ball.

60' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Juan Musso guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
59' Etrit Berisha comes off his line to intercept the corner from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta).
58' Great teamplay by Empoli as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
51' 0 - 3 Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
51' Atalanta force their opponents to concede a corner.
49' The ball has crossed the sideline. Atalanta are taking a throw-in.
47' Razvan Marin (Empoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Juan Musso intercepts the ball.
46' Half-time substitution. Gian Piero Gasperini decided to make a change. Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) is replaced by Rafael Toloi.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Luca Massimi has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. He hits the ball poorly and sends it into orbit.
45+1' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
42' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
39' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
39' The ball is out of play and Atalanta manage to earn a corner.
37' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Juan Musso, who smothers the ball.
36' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
35' A yellow card for a tackle by Liberato Cacace (Empoli). Luca Massimi doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
34' Corner kick. Empoli will have an opportunity.
34' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Empoli! Play can continue.

34' Play continues despite the shouts by some Empoli players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Luca Massimi interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
33' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) attempts to discuss the decision with Luca Massimi, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
33' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
32' The ball is out of play. Atalanta will have a throw-in.
31' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Luca Massimi blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) commits a rough foul. Luca Massimi stops the game and makes a call.

29' 0 - 2 A superb goal from great team play! Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot into the middle of the net. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
27' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
25' A lofted pass finds Ederson (Atalanta) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar.
24' A cross finds Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta), who controls it well and lashes the ball towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper is alert and pulls off a brilliant diving save.
23' Etrit Berisha makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded low towards the middle of the goal by Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) after a cross from the side.
22' Ederson (Atalanta) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
20' A goal, which was scored by Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta), was disallowed due to offside.
19' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
17' Post! Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) latches on to a sweet pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which only hits the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
15' A snap shot by Razvan Marin (Empoli) from distance flies well wide of the right post.
13' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Luca Massimi blows his whistle for an infringement.
11' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Luca Massimi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
10' Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
9' The ball is behind the touchline and Empoli will take a throw-in.
5' 0 - 1 GOAL! Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) finishes off a sublime move with a delightful back-heel goal. Ademola Lookman provided the assist with a brilliant pass. 0:1.
4' Neat passing move from Atalanta in order to create new attacking opportunities.
2' The ball is behind the sideline. Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) takes a throw-in.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Atalanta will have the kick-off.
Luca Massimi is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
